plugins.name: CPA Egress Quality Guard
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI plugin that ports the grok2api egress quality-guard design: measures per-credential output tokens/second (audit-panel parity), immediately quarantines credentials that exceed the hard TPS threshold (downgraded/abnormal buffering), triggers a fixed-prompt active re-probe on soft hits, isolates quarantined credentials in scheduler.pick with minimum-healthy protection, and automatically recovers credentials after a healthy re-probe.
plugins.author: imHansiy
